results.question: Compare on-premises and public cloud hosting in Executive Summary.pdf in terms of upfront cost and scalability. Address both options.

result.answer:
- On-premises:
 - Upfront cost: High (hardware, infrastructure) [S1]; requires significant capital such as $200K–$500K upfront for NVIDIA A100 or H100 servers, networking, storage, and cooling [S2].
 - Scalability: Limited by purchased capacity [S1][S3], though GPUs can be added gradually [S3].
- Public cloud:
 - Upfront cost: Virtually none (reliant on provider) [S1].
 - Scalability: Easy to start, scale, and virtually unlimited [S1]; easier to scale up/down with user demand, including auto-scaling for inference [S3].

results.question: List all core MVP features and all suggested additional features in Executive Summary.pdf.

result.answer:
- Core / MVP Features: AI-generated video lessons, topic-wise notes and summaries, test series and quizzes, question bank and Q&A, performance analytics, and Q&A and forum features [S1][S3][S5][S6][S8].
- Additional / Later Features: Adaptive learning paths, live doubt-solving forum, progress tracking and analytics, gamification, multilingual support, and offline access and mobile app [S1][S2][S6].
- AI-generated Video Lessons: Included as a core MVP feature for producing automated topic-based lecture videos with synthesized speech and optional avatar presentation [S1][S3][S6].
- Adaptive Learning Paths: Included as a suggested additional feature to personalize recommendations based on student performance analytics [S1][S2][S6].
- Gamification: Included as a suggested additional feature featuring badges, streaks, points, and leaderboards to motivate engagement [S1][S2][S6].
- Live Doubt-Solving Forum: Included as a suggested additional feature allowing students to post questions for AI or human tutors, with notifications and tracking [S2].
- Multilingual Support: Included as a suggested additional feature to extend content to Hindi and other regional languages [S1][S2][S6].
- Offline Access & Mobile App: Included as a suggested additional feature to allow downloading videos and notes for offline study [S2].
- Progress Tracking & Analytics: Included as a suggested additional/later feature providing dashboards for students and teachers showing mastery levels, time spent, and topic coverage [S1][S2][S6].
- Question Bank & Q&A: Included as a core MVP feature consisting of a searchable database of Q&A by topic where students can ask the AI questions in natural language or browse curated question collections [S1][S5][S6].
- Test Series & Quizzes: Included as a core MVP feature for auto-creating practice tests, MCQs, short-answer problems, and full mock exams aligned to the syllabus [S1][S5][S6].
- Topic-wise Notes & Summaries: Included as a core MVP feature that generates concise, structured study notes with explanations, key definitions, worked examples, and formula summaries [S1][S5][S6].
